selected_element.description: A spreadsheet cell flagged capabilities.editable = true (not a formula cell).

expected_user_goal: Replace a single cell's value, with the same review/confirm/write-back guarantees as a text edit.
success_criteria: A governed proposal is created showing old value -> new value clearly
Formula cells are refused as read-only rather than silently overwritten
After confirmation, the write succeeds and the new value is visible in the grid
Undo/redo affordance remains available after the write
safety_expectations: requires_confirmation is true on the proposal
Attempting to edit a read-only (formula) cell produces an explicit refusal, not a silent no-op
Execution is blocked if the underlying workbook changed since the proposal was created
hints: Cover both an editable cell and, separately, an attempted edit of a formula cell to exercise the read-only refusal path.
